seoTitle: About Practeva | Business analysis firm in Lagos State, Nigeria
description: Practeva Limited (RC 9931539) is a business analysis and technology advisory firm in Lagos State, Nigeria, registered on 12 October 2026.

hero.title: A business and technology firm that thinks like an *analyst*.
hero.sub: {{company.legalName}} was registered in Nigeria in October 2026 and works with organisations in Nigeria and abroad. It does three things well: advise organisations on their processes, systems and automation, train the analysts who do that work, and help them show it to employers.
